description: A dynaset and a snapshot over T, each Move 2 (ID 3) with held Field K; read Bookmark of each. db.Execute (dbFailOnError) UPDATE T SET K = 333 WHERE ID = 3 and INSERT INTO T VALUES (7, 70, 'g'). Requery each; then for each read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, ID, the held K, Bookmark, LastModified, RecordCount, and RecordCount after MoveLast. Then Requery on a table-type recordset. Asks the position, held Field, bookmark and population after Requery. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
